newsitem.title: USA: News Corp declines comment on Echostar.
newsitem.headline: News Corp declines comment on Echostar.

text.p: News Corp Ltd declined comment after EchoStar Communications Corp said Monday it amended and "significantly" expanded the scope of its suit against News Corp.
"We have no comment other than to say we will contest the matter in court," a spokesman said.
EchoStar cited "many uncured material breaches" by News Corp after the collapse of their February deal to create a direct-TV satellite system.
Asked whether there were any chance the agreement could be kept alive, a spokesman said it was "very unlikely."
Asked whether News Corp were considering an alliance with EchoStar competitor PrimeStar, the spokesman declined to comment, except to say, "There are a lot of options we're looking at."
PrimeStar is a satellite-TV company controlled by Tele-Communications Inc, Time Warner Inc, Comcast Corp and Cox Communications Inc.
